'''Pain Makers''' was a Swedish clan formed by teenage friends {{Player|hEmoGloBiN|flag=se|link=bps}}, {{Player|OcYruS|flag=se}} and {{Player|iNciNeRaTe|flag=se}}. Mostly battling it out on friendly LANs versus eachother, other close class friends were added to the ranks. 

The clan only appeared once outside their LAN bubble, only to win [[The Mean Tournament]] in [[1999]].
